_meta.indication: Treatment of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer (CRC) who have been previously treated with fluoropyrimidine-, oxaliplatin- and irinotecan-based chemotherapy, an anti-VEGF therapy, and, if KRAS wild type, an anti-EGFR therapy

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in the reviewed FDA documents
pivotal_trials.design: Single, multicenter, randomized (2:1), double-blind, placebo-controlled trial
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with previously treated metastatic colorectal cancer; all received prior fluoropyrimidine-, oxaliplatin-, and irinotecan-based chemotherapy and bevacizumab, and KRAS wild-type patients received panitumumab or cetuximab
pivotal_trials.n: 760 patients randomized; 753 received at least 1 dose (500 regorafenib, 253 placebo)
pivotal_trials.result: Median OS 6.4 months (95% CI 5.8, 7.3) with regorafenib vs 5.0 months (95% CI 4.4, 5.8) with placebo; HR 0.77 (95% CI 0.64, 0.94; p=0.0102). Supportive: median PFS 2.0 vs 1.7 months, HR 0.49 (95% CI 0.42, 0.58; p<0.0001).

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (>=30%) are asthenia/fatigue, decreased appetite and food intake, hand-foot skin reaction (HFSR/PPE), diarrhea, mucositis, weight loss, infection, hypertension, and dysphonia. HFSR/PPE 45% vs 7% placebo; diarrhea 43% vs 17%. Most serious adverse reactions are hepatotoxicity, hemorrhage, and gastrointestinal perforation.
target_moa: Small molecule inhibitor of multiple kinases (including BRAF, VEGFR 1/2/3, TIE2, PDGFR, FGFR, RET, and KIT) involved in oncogenesis and tumor angiogenesis; interferes with both tumor-cell proliferation and tumor angiogenesis

boxed_warning.content: WARNING: HEPATOTOXICITY — Severe and sometimes fatal hepatotoxicity has been observed in clinical trials. Monitor hepatic function prior to and during treatment. Interrupt and then reduce or discontinue Stivarga for hepatotoxicity.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee was convened; the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues unexpected for a drug of this class in the intended population
